label: Debtor 1 caption (application p1 and Order p4)
why: No name appears on the application: the schema key "Debtor" matches no widget (DIG-64).

label: Estimate your average monthly expenses
why: The value goes into the line 5 narrative box instead.

label: Do you expect your family's average monthly net income to increase or decrease by more than 10% during the next 6 months?
why: Required answer; no box is ticked.

label: Do these expenses cover anyone who is not included in your family as reported in line 1?
why: Required answer. The No box's on_state is "On", not "no".

label: Does anyone other than you regularly pay any of these expenses?
Do you expect your average monthly expenses to increase or decrease by more than 10% during the next 6 months?
Payments for bankruptcy services (paid / promised / paid on your behalf)
why: Required No/Yes answers. Whether DigniFi counts as a preparer is the same § 110 question raised on 106Dec.

label: Have you filed for bankruptcy within the last 8 years?
why: Required answer; a prior_bankruptcy_gate predicate exists but is unused here.

label: Part 3 property: cash, bank accounts, home, other real estate, vehicles
why: Part 3 is blank. The form allows attaching Schedule A/B instead ("If you have already filled out Schedule A/B ... attach copies and go to Part 4"), but nothing marks that the schedule is attached.

label: Date of Debtor 1 signature; Debtor 1 continuation captions (p2, p3)
why: Both are unbound. Unlike the other forms, 103B binds no signature-date key at all.
